rationale: A third party (neighbor's child) sustained a broken wrist due to a hazard on the policyholder's premises (icy walkway), creating a clear liability exposure for premises liability coverage.
claim_summary: Nine-year-old neighbor's child fell on ice on policyholder's front walkway during recent ice storm and sustained a broken wrist. Medical bills are pending. High-severity pediatric injury claim on active homeowners policy with $500k liability coverage.

case_facts.location: walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: child slipped on ice and fell
